title: Mountain Man
description: Phuntsho Tshering is the only glaciologist in Bhutan. He is also the only person that has permission to climb the sacred mountains. Every year, he travels for days on foot to the most remote corners of the Bhutanese Himalaya, measuring the glaciers as they rapidly melt because of climate change. For Tshering's 11-year-old daughter Yangchen, the mountain is the home of the "snow lion," which is both dangerous and in danger of losing its home.

title: Crypto Man
description:
"You should live up to the expectations."

Struggling under the immense weight of his mother Ok-ja's expectations, Do-hyun forges residency documents to enter Seoul's prestigious Daechi-dong school district. This early taste of manipulation sparks a larger ambition: to master the very system that once denied him opportunity. When a wealthy classmate exploits disability benefits to claim a coveted exchange program slot, Do-hyun's disillusionment turns into fierce determination.

At university, he partners with Ji-woo-a like-minded entrepreneur who shares his skepticism toward conventional meritocracy-to tap into government-funded "blind money," youth entrepreneurship subsidies distributed with minimal oversight. Exploiting credits meant for socially disadvantaged groups, they deliberately engineer business failures, requalifying for fresh subsidies at every turn. Their calculated approach catches the eye of Kevin, an influential investor who bankrolls Do-hyun's most audacious venture yet: "MOMMY coin," a cryptocurrency poised to revolutionize wealth creation. As the coin's value skyrockets, Do-hyun becomes a media sensation, embodying South Korea's obsession with rapid success. Yet beneath the triumphant headlines lies a fragile foundation-his unrefined algorithm and ethically dubious practices draw scrutiny from financial regulators.

Inspired by real-life incidents, Do-hyun's story is a cautionary tale about ambition, systemic loopholes, and the moral gray areas between innovation and exploitation. When the house of cards he built begins to collapse, Do-hyun is forced to confront whether the true culprit is the broken system or the very people who exploit it.

title: The Mark
description:
Sherri Holland is fresh out of an abusive relationship and residing in a rundown women's shelter when she meets Trevon Le'Mont, a charming man of the streets who preys on women down on their luck with low self-esteem. After convincing Sherri to help him pull a scam on multi-billionaire, technology guru, Brian Easley, Trevon transforms Sherri into a stunning, classy woman.

Having absolutely nothing to lose, Sherri assumes the role of "Candy Apple," a woman that Brian has been falling for on a dating site for months. Unbeknownst to Brian, he has really been the "Mark" of Trevon, who has a string of women scamming men to line his pockets. He considers himself the player of a greater game instead of the typical womanizer. He has his methods down to a science... until he meets his match in Sherri.

Sherri was supposed to merely be another notch on his belt, and his bedpost, but Trevon finds himself falling for her. Even his closest friends can tell that Sherri has him under her spell. But what happens when Sherri stops taking Trevon's calls and funneling him cash? When she decides that she is sick of being used and manipulated by man after man? After she finds out neither Brian nor Trevon have been totally transparent with her? When Sherri realizes that one of them is playing with her heart and the other one is playing with her mind? It is a cat-and-mouse game that ultimately turns deadly, and only time will tell who will emerge the victor.

Charismatic characters, striking cinematography, incredible music, and heart-stopping, unexpected moments all collide in Mark Deniro's "The Mark."

title: Dark Waves
description: Strange events in the open sea haunt two young lovers in this supernatural fantasy. When the couple finds rare gold, they unlock a dark adventure filled with zombie pirates out for vengeance.

title: Opening Night
description: A high school teenager navigates the final minutes before his first stage performance, which includes experiencing his first kiss - unfortunately, in front of a live audience. Despite his rising anxiety, he finds comfort in a fellow classmate as they share a romantic moment.

title: Night Sweats
description: A madam finds her business slowly becoming a human trafficking ring.

title: Night Party
description: Ronit loves his blogging wife Supriya but frets over her earnings. His friend Rony makes money entertaining at kitty parties. Rony offers the same job to Ronit, who wonders - will Supriya approve?

title: Night Feeder
description: Fear chokes the free-wheeling underbelly of San Francisco's punk scene as a killer stalks the night to feed an unspeakable appetite. Community suspicion focuses on Disease, a band that is tainted by groupie deaths allegedly induced by the drug DZS, and on "The Creeper" a misshapen outcast from the bowels of the city. A writer probes the gruesome murders and the story hits close to home, as the web of death devours neighbors, friends, and lovers.

title: Night Sights
description: After losing his son, a grieving father stumbles upon a network of people that collect souls of the deceased, preparing them for their journey out of Purgatory.

description: After three years of devotion, Faye Hart is abandoned by Lucien, a proud pureblood panther who chooses a wealthy heiress over her. While Faye fights for her second chance at happiness, the panther who betrayed her must face the devastating cost of losing her forever.

Despite this, on her own birthday, Annie chose to give her mother one final chance.

title: Videoke King
description: Overseas worker Ning Ning makes two separate favors to her fiancé King and her cousin Lally. Despite their low tolerance for each others' idiosyncrasies, they grudgingly carry out Ning Ning's wishes. But somewhere in the course of the homebuilding project, King and Lally develop feelings for each other. What they do not know is that Ning Ning actually has plans that they cannot deter.

title: Evil Kin
description: It's amazing the things that you can inherit from your family gene pool: blue eyes, a beautiful smile, a winning personality. But what about your family's less desirable traits? A grandfather's talent for swindling, an aunt's knack for aggravated assault or even a father's flair for murder.... can you actually inherit evil from your family tree? Evil Kin begs this question as well as whether psychopathic behavior is pre-programmed. From siblings who conspire to kill their parents, to three brothers who grow up independently to become a serial killer, a rapist and a mercenary, Evil Kin follows true-crime mysteries surrounding bone-chilling cases that prove blood is always thicker than water.

title: Bigg Boss Kannada
description: Bigg Boss Kannada is a reality show based on the Hindi show Bigg Boss which too was based on the original Dutch Big Brother. A number of contestants (known as "housemates") live in a purpose-built house and are isolated from the rest of the world. Each week, housemates nominate two of their fellow housemates for eviction, and the housemates who receives the most nominations would face a public vote. Eventually, one housemate would leave after being "convicted" from the House. In the final week, there were five housemates remaining, and the public voted for who they wanted to win. Housemates are overseen by a mysterious person known as 'Bigg Boss', whose only presence in the house is through his voice.

title: Two Lost Worlds
description: When the American clipper ship "The Queen" is attacked by pirates off the Hebrides in 1830, Mate Kirk Hamilton is injured and must be put ashore at Queensland Colony, Australia, for treatment and recuperation. There, he meets and falls in love with Elaine Jeffries, daughter of the magistrate and all-but-fiancée to rancher Martin Shannon. She also finds herself attracted to Kirk, and a rivalry develops between the two men. Meantime the pirates, led by Captain Hackett, decide to raid the colony and, in the process kidnap Elaine and her friend. Nancy. Kirk, and Shannon lead the pursuit, having not only the romantic triangle to resolve, but the pirates to overcome and, along the way, being stranded on a volcanic island inhabited by dinosaurs.

title: Sunset Story
description: Lucille and Irja are retired residents of Sunset Hall, a Los Angeles home for the elderly. Residents of Sunset Hall are retired radicals; they have retired from work but not from protesting against injustice. Bitter Lucille considers herself a realist. Wheelchair-bound Irja is sunny and optimistic. Lucille was raised a Jew but always aspired to assimilate. Irja wants to explore all sorts of new traditions. title: The Story
description: A team of nine from the US and Canada band together on a journey of hope and adventure to Africa. Arriving in Dar es Salaam, they begin as privileged vacationers on Safari. After exploring the beauty and charm of Africa, the team travels on a day's journey into the heart of Africa, where they seek to make a difference among AIDS orphans and the Inala village in Tanzania. Dealing with their own preconceived ideas, prejudices and past hurts, they find courage and personal transformation in the most unexpected people and places. Eating strange food, living in small huts and helping the indigenous village, they discover that their journey is much more than an exercise in volunteerism. It's a journey of discovering who they really are.

title: Pls.Love
description: Panapsorn has spent years surviving the glittering, merciless world of nightlife entertainment, remaining soft-spoken, selfless, and carrying wounds she learned to hide behind flawless smiles. Phakinee, on the other hand, has never had to hide anything. Beautiful, wealthy, and razor-sharp, she moves through life untouched by the things that break ordinary people, until she meets Panapsorn, whose quiet strength unsettles her in ways she cannot explain away. An unexpected encounter becomes a pull neither woman can escape. But in a world ruled by power, secrets, and the ghosts of what came before, choosing each other is an act of courage. A fierce, aching, modern sapphic romance about two women, one learning she deserves love and one discovering she can feel it, as they fight for a connection neither of them saw coming.

title: KEMBALINYA SANG PUTRI
description:
Terlahir dalam keluarga kaya, Lin Xiaxia seharusnya tumbuh bahagia dan berkecukupan. Namun, akibat konflik keluarga, Lin Yue menukarnya dengan putrinya sendiri, Shen Qinghe, sehingga nasib kedua gadis itu berubah drastis.

Lin Xiaxia tumbuh dengan penuh penindasan di keluarga Lin dan terpaksa melepaskan cintanya. Meski begitu, ia tidak menyerah pada impiannya. Berkat kerja kerasnya, ia berhasil mencapai final kompetisi desain, tempat ia tanpa sengaja bertemu kembali dengan cinta pertamanya, Li Jingxing, serta ibu kandungnya. Namun, Jingxing telah bertunangan dengan Shen Qinghe, sementara ibu kandung Xiaxia justru memandang rendah dirinya. Karena Jingxing masih belum bisa melupakan Xiaxia, Qinghe diliputi kecemburuan dan melancarkan berbagai aksi balas dendam terhadapnya. Pada akhirnya, rahasia masa lalu terungkap. Xiaxia kembali ke keluarga Shen dan akhirnya bersatu dengan Li Jingxing.

title: Tangisan Tiga Saudaraku
description: Elisa, gadis setengah manusia dan setengah vampir, percaya bahwa si kembar tiga Lockhart adalah satu-satunya orang di dunia yang benar-benar bisa ia percaya. Dia ingin menjadi manusia demi mereka—dan menghabiskan sisa hidupnya bersama salah satu dari mereka. Namun, segalanya berubah saat Amber, putri pelayan mereka, muncul. Berkali-kali Elisa diabaikan, dipermalukan, dan direnggut harga dirinya demi Amber. Akhirnya, ia memutuskan untuk merelakan mereka dan menerima takdirnya: meninggalkan Sekolah Siang, pindah ke Sekolah Malam, dan menjadi vampir seutuhnya. Namun, saat Elisa muncul dalam balutan seragam Sekolah Malam di pelukan seorang pewaris vampir yang berkuasa, mengapa si kembar tiga yang pernah membuangnya tiba-tiba panik dan menyesal—serta berlutut memohon ampun padanya?

title: Mencuri  Pacar CEO kakakku
description:
Demi membiayai pembedahan bapanya, Mu Qianyue menyamar sebagai anak sulung keluarga Gu untuk menggantikan Gu Qianqian yang melarikan diri daripada perkahwinan. Dia berkahwin dengan seorang lelaki yang diselubungi pelbagai khabar angin. Pada zahirnya, dia melakukannya demi sepuluh juta, tetapi tujuan sebenarnya adalah untuk menyelamatkan masa depan bapanya.
Di syarikat keluarga Gu, Mu Qianyue bijak menangani provokasi Yun Weiwei sambil merahsiakan identitinya. Yun Weiwei berulang kali memasang perangkap untuk membongkar penyamarannya, tetapi semuanya berjaya dipatahkan oleh Mu Qianyue. Apabila bapanya dihina dalam sebuah majlis, dia tampil mempertahankannya dan membongkar muslihat Yun Weiwei.
Akhirnya, suaminya mengetahui identiti sebenar Mu Qianyue, namun memilih untuk melindunginya. Segala kejahatan Yun Weiwei terbongkar sehingga dia disenaraihitamkan sepenuhnya. Dengan bantuan suaminya, Mu Qianyue membongkar konspirasi keluarga Gu, menemukan asal usul dirinya yang sebenar, dan bersama-sama melangkah ke masa depan.

title: Pewaris Kaya Terlahir Kembali demi Balas Dendam Cinta
description:
Choi Cheong-yeon dan Kim Myeong-nam adalah sepasang kekasih yang harus melewati berbagai cobaan. Krisis perusahaan keluarga dan rumitnya hubungan dengan orang-orang di sekitarnya membuat Cheong-yeon terjebak dalam kesulitan. Myeong-nam mencintainya dengan tulus dan setia, tetapi kesalahpahaman serta intrik pihak lain merenggangkan hubungan mereka.
Di tengah siasat jahat Park Yong-jun dan Choi Hyo-jin, keduanya mengalami penderitaan demi penderitaan. Myeong-nam bahkan sempat terluka parah. Namun, berbekal cinta dan kepercayaan satu sama lain, mereka berhasil membongkar seluruh konspirasi dan mengatasi segala rintangan.
Myeong-nam akhirnya menggagalkan rencana Yong-jun dan menyelamatkan Grup Choi dari krisis, sementara Cheong-yeon berhasil membersihkan nama baik keluarganya. Keduanya pun bersatu, membuktikan bahwa cinta sejati mampu mengalahkan segala kesulitan dan tantangan.

title: The Substitute
description: Depicts the story of a high-achieving, low-income student who takes the College Scholastic Ability Test (CSAT) for another person to avoid blackmail. Children are placed on an exam stage where they risk falling behind in life if they do not complete the CSAT safely. To obtain the "score" that will determine their future, a survival CSAT war unfolds thrillingly with betrayals and tricks everywhere. It is expected to expose the dark side of entrance exams unflinchingly through the "unfair" children who search for the correct answer amid extreme dilemmas.

title: Popular Serizawa Acts Weird Around Me
description: Suzuki, a loner student, secretly wrote a BL novel using the name of Serizawa, a popular guy in a group of outgoing people, as his model. But when Serizawa ends up reading it, Suzuki panics, convinced he'll be mocked. Instead, Serizawa unexpectedly showers it with praise. From that day on, Serizawa keeps finding reasons to hang around him and invite him out. Before Suzuki can even process what's happening, Serizawa steadily closes the distance between them. "Why me!?" Yet Serizawa only becomes more persistent. "I'm not planning to let you get away, Suzuki." Before he realizes it, Suzuki finds himself being swept along at Serizawa's pace as the two grow unexpectedly close.

title: "Africa's Epic Wonders: Journey Through Its Most Stunning Places!" | 4K Video
description: Embark on an unforgettable journey through "Africa's Majestic Landscapes: A Geographical Odyssey"! This stunning TV documentary takes you across the continent’s most awe-inspiring natural wonders, from the life-giving Nile River to the snow-capped summit of Mount Kilimanjaro, the thundering Victoria Falls, and the wildlife-rich Ngorongoro Crater. Witness the Great Migration in the Maasai Mara and Serengeti, explore the vast Sahara Desert, glide through the Okavango Delta’s waterways, and stand atop Cape Town’s iconic Table Mountain. With breathtaking aerial visuals, captivating narration, and a powerful orchestral score infused with African rhythms, this documentary unveils the secrets of Africa’s diverse landscapes, their cultural significance, and the challenges they face in a changing world. Perfect for nature lovers, adventure seekers, and anyone fascinated by the beauty and resilience of our planet! Highlights: The Nile’s 6,650km journey sustaining ancient and modern civilizations Kilimanjaro’s sacred slopes and disappearing glaciers The Great Migration’s epic struggle for survival Victoria Falls’ raw power and misty rainbows The Sahara’s ancient secrets and resilient nomads Okavango Delta’s wildlife paradise Table Mountain’s biodiversity and timeless allure Subscribe for more epic nature documentaries and hit the bell to never miss an adventure! Share your favorite African landscape in the comments below! #Africa #NatureDocumentary #Geography #Wildlife #Travel #Adventure

title: Excel Skills for Business: Advanced
description:
This advanced Excel course is designed for business professionals, data analysts, and financial analysts seeking to master complex spreadsheet software for data-driven decision-making. Building on foundational Excel skills, this program will transform you into a power user, enhancing your employability and positioning you ahead in a rapidly evolving digital job market. (Source: World Economic Forum 2023 Future of Jobs Report).
By the end of this course, you will be able to:
- Master advanced Excel formulas and lookup functions for efficient data handling.
- Clean and prepare complex data for robust analysis using Microsoft Excel.
- Apply financial functions and date formulas for business calculations and reporting.
- Design and build professional, interactive dashboards in Excel for business intelligence.
To be successful, you should have completed the Excel Skills for Business: Essentials, Intermediate I, and Intermediate II courses, or possess equivalent intermediate Microsoft Excel proficiency.

title: Using Python to Access Web Data
description: This course will show how one can treat the Internet as a source of data. We will scrape, parse, and read web data as well as access data using web APIs. We will work with HTML, XML, and JSON data formats in Python. This course will cover Chapters 11-13 of the textbook “Python for Everybody”. To succeed in this course, you should be familiar with the material covered in Chapters 1-10 of the textbook and the first two courses in this specialization. These topics include variables and expressions, conditional execution (loops, branching, and try/except), functions, Python data structures (strings, lists, dictionaries, and tuples), and manipulating files. This course covers Python 3.

title: Programming in Python
description:
In this course, you will be introduced to foundational programming skills with basic Python Syntax. You’ll learn how to use code to solve problems. You’ll dive deep into the Python ecosystem and learn popular modules, libraries and tools for Python. 
You’ll also get hands-on with objects, classes and methods in Python, and utilize variables, data types, control flow and loops, functions and data structures. You’ll learn how to recognize and handle errors and you’ll write unit tests for your Python code and practice test-driven development.
By the end of this course, you will be able to:
•	Prepare your computer system for Python programming
•	Show understanding of Python syntax and how to control the flow of code
•	Demonstrate knowledge of how to handle errors and exceptions
•	Explain object-oriented programming and the major concepts associated with it
•	Explain the importance of testing in Python, and when to apply particular methods
This is a beginner course for learners who would like to prepare themselves for a career in back-end development or database engineering. To succeed in this course, you do not need prior web development experience, only basic internet navigation skills and an eagerness to get started with coding.

title: The Vanishing Beauty
description: Meng Yu, an only child from the Yangtze River Delta region and a popular online blogger, was considered a "lucky woman" envied by the people around her. On the occasion of her fifth wedding anniversary, however, her seemingly perfect and happy life crumbled. Not only did her marriage to her "model" husband begin to unravel, but she also faced numerous crises, including being exploited and financially drained by her in-laws. With the help of her friends, Meng Yu reevaluated her life and took back control of her destiny.

title: Cewek Super Bikin Baper
description:
SURI, tabib muda yang punya kekuatan super mendadak menikah dengan NIKO, laki-laki yang lumpuh dan juga punya penyakit jantung bawaan. Hidup Niko bahkan divonis tidak akan bertahan lama. Makanya Niko butuh ramuan madu hutan ajaib dari tabib terkenal bernama tabib raja hutan untuk menyembuhkan dirinya.
Suri merasa yakin bisa menyembuhkan kaki dan penyakit Niko dengan kekuatannya sendiri. Suri bahkan sampai kesal karena Niko tetap berusaha mencari tabib raja hutan. Belum lagi adiktirinya, MUTIARA, yang tidak sengaja menemukan lambang perguruantabib raja hutan, langsung mengaku sebagai murid dari tabib ituuntuk merebut Niko. 
Namun ternyata, Suri adalah cucu dari tabib raja hutan yang selama ini mereka cari dan bicarakan. Tapi apakah Suri betul-betul bisa menyembuhkan kaki dan penyakit jantung Niko dengankekuatannya sendiri?

title: The Bacchus Lady
description: The Bacchus Lady looks into the issue of elderly prostitution in South Korea. So-Young, an elderly lady who provides sex services to the male senior citizens using the pretext of selling Bacchus (an energy drink) to them. When So-Young picks up a Korean-Filipino boy named Min-Ho from the clinic she visits after Min-Ho's mother stabs the doctor (Min-Ho's father), she takes care of him while seeking a living through prostitution. From her interactions with her former clients, she finds that the golden age in their silver years may not be that bright after all.

title: Despertar: O Mundo o Espera
description: Há seis anos, o presidente da Associação Mundial de Neurologia recusou convites de instituições médicas de elite para se dedicar a uma única missão, garantir a recuperação de uma pessoa extraordinária. Durante esse período, essa figura permaneceu em um quarto de luxo, com sua condição envolta em mistério. Não se tratava de um paciente comum – seis anos atrás, essa pessoa havia mudado o curso da história. Agora, com o despertar iminente, o mundo está prestes a testemunhar o retorno de uma lenda, cujas ações prometem transformar a realidade e trazer mudanças sísmicas.

title: M
description: M is a work of art that explores the relationship between sexuality and death. These two appear to be opposite forces, but in fact they merge in all of us, disguising the fear of death or the desire to die, the world of Eros and Thanatos. In M the character of Marilyn Monroe should be seen as a symbol of this interpenetration. The actress's death is as famous as her sexuality and thus sets a perfect example of how the ancient bond between sex and death is being forever mystified and exploited by the popular culture. M attempts to explore this phenomenon in a much more personal level. All the events in the work are fictional and they are set in no particular place or time. The work consists of film material that has been produced on and off in a time period of four years, beginning in March 2013 to December 2017. The footage was shot mainly in the home and grounds of Casa das Musas Art House in Nazare, Portugal. Other shooting locations were Litibu village in Mexico and Uusikaupunki, Finland. All the actors in the work are non-professionals and were chosen because of their strong essence and character. Although the work is based on a script the roles and events were adjusted to fit the actors presence, and all of the dialogue was acted by the artist herself as voiceover. At times the process of filming was on the verge of improvisation and therefore only the afterwork would fully determine how some of the scenes developed. This way of working turned out to be a crucial element of the work. M is not an attempt to tell a story or redefine a character. In fact it is quite the opposite. The elements of film are being used as pathways for the artist to move in and out of the characters, each character representing somewhat a side of the artists own fantasy. By placing herself in the part of an object of fantasy the artist strives to understand the unity of sex and death, not merely as a myth in popular culture, but as an integral part of humanity.

title: P A R A L L E L
L... kot ljubezen
description: About young people from ex-Yugoslavia who live and work in Prague--"center of emigrant crosses." The story follows young film director Gina, who is about to shoot her first feature film, but hasn't the script or the money. The only thing she is certain of is that it must be about love--true love. Before consciously finding the right story to tell, she begins to make a movie about her life and the lives of her closest friends. The involvement of a Mafia spy, a President Bush doll, a transvestite flatmate, an ex-boyfriend, a sclerotic grandmother and a Mafia boss not only causes a lot of surprises, danger, and broken hearts, but also emotional struggles and unexpected comical situations.

title: Quantum G-d
description: Quantum G-d is a 96 pages script and a presentation deck, for a science documentary, written, from the scientific optics, by scientists from the California Institute of Technology, Caltech, listed as the most important institute of technology in the world, and one of the main universities along with Harvard, MIT and Oxford. Throughout the script, the physicists formulate questions and provide the answers through different professional perspectives according to each area of study. This is accompanied with a series of mind blowing, never before seen animations that will be used in schools to teach quantum physics for an entire generation. The script, which includes the pointed questions and the novel animations, will challenge the top minds in theoretical physics to re-evaluate our ideas of how the universe works through the lens of quantum entanglement. One of the writers serves as the manager for Caltech's Institute for Quantum Information and Matter, and he was a scientific consultant in Marvel's blockbuster movies, including Ant Man, Spider Man Homecoming, Ant Man and the Wasp, Infinity War, Captain Marvel, Doctor Strange, Avengers: Endgame and Fantastic Voyage (dir: Guillermo del Toro, prod: James Cameron). The narrative was constructed with the help of another scientist, a cell and molecular pathologist and research associate at the Doheny Eye Institute in Los Angeles, who co-wrote the viral shorts films, "Anyone Can Quantum" and "Quantum is Calling" which featured Stephen Hawking, Paul Rudd, Keanu Reeves, Zoe Saldana, Simon Pegg and John Cho respectively.

title: C-Bear and Jamal
description: Jamal passes through his 10th birthday, and in the process of 'becoming a man', which is what this milestone means, he tries to give up childhood things, including C Bear, his teddy bear. C Bear and Jamal talk to each other, and C Bear can create imaginary scenarios for Jamal - he shows Jamal what adulthood can mean, and how passing 10 does not mean that all of childhood must be abandoned.

title: The First Jasmine
description: Li Ye marries Xiuyao Mo while her sister Ying Ye weds Li Ye's childhood friend Jingli Mo. Sealed on Mount Li for eight years, Li Ye secretly avenges officials who harmed her home. She and Xiuyao unite to help emperor defeat conspiracies.

title: Vice ibinahagi ang pangarap para sa relasyon nila ni Ion
description:
Oooh lala-van na lavan ang pitik ng bewang nina Baby Dolls Arianne, Chloe, Johaira, Juby, Jelai, Eriel, and Ina. To welcome their era as an official P-Pop group at kauna-unahang Hype Group ng bayan, ginanap ang Baby Dolls Day.

Present ang mga social media personalities, Kapamilya at Kapuso "PBB" ex-housemates, beauty queens, P-Pop groups, "Tawag Ng Tanghalan" alumni, "Showtime Online U" hosts, at All-Star Games Basketball at Volleyball Team para makigiling.

Pagkatapos ng Baby Dolls Day celebration, bumida naman ang beki na may talak para sa buong nation. Meet CY ng Quezon City, Fema Braganza ng Pangasinan, at BRIGIT ng Laguna, ang mga talakera na sumubok masungkit ang korona sa Miss Q and A.

Minsan ang talak, may pagka-harsh, parang comment ni Ogie Alcasid, na hindi inurungan sa puksaan si Vhong Navarro. Kaya ang ilong ni Vhong, napuruhan sa laitan!

Naloka naman ang Madlang People sa sagot ng mga kandidata sa unang tanong sa Tumpak Ganern tungkol sa karakter sa Noli Me Tangere na sinasabing ama ni Maria Clara. Ang sagot ni BRIGIT, "Nutridamus!" Kaya biro ni Vice Ganda, kapatid ba 'yan ni Nutri Bun?

Sina Fema at CY ang umabante sa next round ng chukchakan, ang Wit Lang. Pagkatapos ng talakan, ang very 'pulchritudinous', sabi ni Brent Manalo, na si CY ang kinoronahan bilang Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era of the day.

Pumadyak ang swerte at good vibes para sa mga pedicab driver na sumalang sa Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Nakaka-touch ang pagiging solid Showtimer ni Tatay Doms, na may iniabot pang liham ng pasasalamat para kay Vice Ganda at sa buong "It's Showtime" family. Pero, si Kim Chiu, nagtampo, dahil wala ang pangalan niya sa sulat na ito.

Pagkatapos ng aktingan, iisa lang ang naka-survive sa laro! Ito ay si Mavin, na kahit mahirap man ang buhay ay nananatiling masayahin. Kapang P300k ang napasakanya, babawi siya sa magulang niya. Pero sapat nang pambawi ang P40,000 na Li-Pot offer kaya dito na siya sa siguradong uuwi siyang panalo.

#ShowtimeBabyDollsDay
#ItsShowtimeFullEpisode 
#ABSCBNEntertainment

title: Nacional B
description: Live TyC Sports coverage of the second division of the Argentine football.

title: B&W
description: Swaranjali is a painter with aspirations of becoming one of the world's greatest painters. During this process, she develops a new type of live musical painting in which she paints while dancing to the music. Vardhan is an aspiring music director who works for film industry. Due to lack of opportunities, he was unable to become what he desired, and in his frustration, he became addicted to drugs. Yamini, as a singer, aspires to reach greater heights in the music industry with her singing talent. She hangs out a lot and doesn't take things seriously in the process, all three become good friends, and because Swaranjali and Vardhan love each other, they begin a living relationship, with Swaranjali morally and financially supporting Vardhan. In the process of introducing her live music painting theme to the world, she meets famous event organizer Rakesh, but Rakesh, being a playboy, wants every girl to be around him rather than helping them. As a neighbor, Papua irritates Swaranjali by knowing about her relationship with Vardhan and tries to attract her while she avoids him. Swaranjali planned a surprise party for Vardhan's birthday and invites all for the party. Vardhan was discovered dead in Swaranjali house on the same day.How does Swaranjali get out of this murder mystery and achieve her goal?

title: Akce B
description: Two years after the end of the Second World War, the remnants of Ukrainian Insurgence Army, called the Bandera's after their former commander Stepan Bandera, are trying to get from Poland through Slovakia to Germany in the West. They resort to sabotages also on Czechoslovak territory, and therefore army and police units are deployed to capture them. Soldiers and policemen are warned about the danger of encountering spies and collaborators of the Bandera's. In the meantime police investigators are arresting catholic clergy for supplying the saboteurs with weapons and false documents. Soldiers are operating in the area of Small Fatra, and it seems there must be someone amongst them who provides the Bandera's with information about planned movements of the army.

title: Plan B
description: A young and struggling fashion stylist navigates through life after a life-altering one night stand.

title: Iskushenie B.
description: The story of a writer who accidentally stumbles across the elixir of immortality and in doing so encounters the small group of immortals who have jealously guarded this secret for centuries.

title: Flat No B 12
description: This story tells about the love beyond the death.

title: Issho ni H Shiyo
description: Your childhood friend has no place to spend the night. She asks you if she could stay at your place. You obviously agree. She comes a little drunk and upon seeing that you have no girlfriend and fap only to hentai (tissues), she decides to make you a man.

title: G-Thing
description: G-Thing follows an Italian-American rapper and his larger-than-life family as they try to launch their first "family-style" run hip-hop label: Tracketeering Records. Viewers will get an inside look at G Fella, along with his unrestrained and crazy relatives, as they do everything they can to achieve musical stardom.

title: Stevie G
description: Director, Umut Gunduz, is Stevie's brother. Whilst Stevie served his last prison sentence to date, the two made contact again after many years silent. It wasn't long before they both began to talk of their childhoods and it was then that Umut suggested the making of a film to Stevie. Having never really grown up together, Umut attempts to discover his brother through the medium of film. As he collects the footage and sifts through hours of family home video, he learns more and more about Stevie and begins to piece the young man together for himself, telling a complex story of guilt and misguided choices that inevitably lead to a life of crime, violence and separation.

title: K Rd Stories
description: Set on New Zealand's most iconic street this collection of 10 short web films explores the uncommon, the contrasting, and the crazy.

title: Doroga k schastyu
description: Anya Kalinina has dreamed of becoming a doctor since childhood. In preparation for entering medical school, Anna works part-time at the post office to help her grandmother a little. Kolya, the son of a local businessman Volkov, has long and hopelessly been in love with Anya. Once a cadet of the Academy of the Ministry of Emergency Situations Artyom comes to visit the girl's neighbor, and Anya falls in love for the first time. Young people spend several days together and agree to meet in a month, so as not to part ever again. But a series of tragic events disrupt their plans.

title: Dive Into You
description: Follows Toon Ha-Na, who is thrown back in time after a near-fatal accident and body-swapped with her twin brother, as she sets out to save her childhood friend and first love from fate.

title: Daan (Marathi - 2020)
description: Daan is an emotional story set up in the city of Osmanabad in Maharashtra. Shiv Shankar, a daily wager is a building painter. His wife Nagmani, daughters Vaishali, Gauri, Radha and son Shiva lives hand to mouth with Shiv Shankar's small earnings.The family somehow survives and enjoy the festivals with neighbours and friends. One fine day Shiv Shankar falls ill. He is taken to a hospital where the doctor advices operation which will need huge. Luck by chance social worker Priya Pawar, reconizes the family and helps Shiv Shankar get operated reminding him of what his son Shiva has done for them. Shiva spends his life helping his friends and moving around aimlessly. He meets with an accident and is admitted in the hospital. Days of treatment do not improve his conditions and he slips into coma and is declared brain dead. Shiv Shankar meets social worker Priya Pawar. She explains him the benefits of body organ donations and how it will help others to gain a new life on behalf of his son Shiva. Shiv Shankar decides to donate Shiva's body organs for a noble deed, without the knowledge of his family. Shiva's sacrifice helped Shiv Shankar get operated free as per Government rule, with the help of Priya Pawar. A young child comes to meet Shiv Shankar in the hospital whose heart has been replaced with Shiva's. Shiv Shankar feels as if Shiva is living in the child. The film DAAN sends a social message to the society about the importance of BODY ORGAN DONATIONS and spread an awareness in the society.

title: Picasso [Marathi]
description: Gandharva, a 7th grade student from a remote village in the Konkan belt of Maharashtra is selected for a National Painting Competition. The winner gets to travel to Spain - Picasso's birthplace - to hone their art. But entering the competition requires a fee that his parents cannot afford. With an ailing mother and a father struggling with debt and alcoholism, the chances of him being able to participate look slim. Gandharva's father Pandurang was once an accomplished stage actor, but his addiction now stands in the way of him performing, which was both his passion and a means to provide for his family. Will Pandurang be able to fight his demons and bring his art back to life - not for himself, but for his son? Picasso is a story about fathers and sons, hope and dreams - of life imitating art, and how art can heal lives.
